items.subject: Chemistry
items.body:
### 🎯 Pauling Electronegativity Hierarchy

**Electronegativity Order:**
$$\text{F (4.0)} > \text{O (3.5)} > \text{N (3.0)} \approx \text{Cl (3.16)} > \text{Br (2.8)} > \text{I (2.5)} \approx \text{S (2.5)} \approx \text{C (2.5)} > \text{P (2.1)} \approx \text{H (2.1)}$$

> 💡 **Memory Hook:** **"FONCl Br I S C H"** — *"Phone Call Brought Ice, Sugar, Chocolate & Honey"*

**Key Exam Application:**
1. **Hydrogen Bonding:** Occurs strictly when Hydrogen is covalently bonded to the top 3 electronegative atoms (**F, O, N**).
2. **Inductive & Dipole Moments:** Predicts direction of electron pull in organic reaction mechanisms.

metadata.hook: FONCl Br I S C H (Phone Call Brought Ice, Sugar, Chocolate & Honey)
metadata.application: Hydrogen bonding (FON only), dipole moments & oxidation state assignment.

items.subject: Physics
items.body:
### ⚡ Complete Electromagnetic Spectrum Order

**Order of Increasing Frequency ($f$) & Energy ($E$), Decreasing Wavelength ($\lambda$):**
$$\text{Radio} < \text{Microwave} < \text{Infrared} < \text{Visible} < \text{Ultraviolet} < \text{X-Ray} < \text{\gamma-Ray}$$

> 💡 **Memory Hook (R-M-I-V-U-X-G):** *"**R**aging **M**artians **I**nvaded **V**enus **U**sing **X**-ray **G**uns"*

**Fundamental Formula:**
$$E = h\nu = \frac{hc}{\lambda} \quad (c = 3 \times 10^8\text{ m/s})$$
- **Radio Waves:** Lowest frequency ($\sim 10^4\text{ Hz}$), longest wavelength ($\sim 10^3\text{ m}$)
- **Gamma Rays ($\gamma$):** Highest frequency ($\sim 10^{20}\text{ Hz}$), highest penetrating energy

metadata.hook: R-M-I-V-U-X-G (Raging Martians Invaded Venus Using X-ray Guns)
metadata.application: Board exam questions on EM wave frequency matching, wavelength ranges & energy comparisons.

items.body:
### 🧪 Activity / Reactivity Series of Metals

**Order from Most Reactive to Least Reactive:**
$$\text{K} > \text{Na} > \text{Ca} > \text{Mg} > \text{Al} > \text{Zn} > \text{Fe} > \text{Pb} > \text{[H]} > \text{Cu} > \text{Hg} > \text{Ag} > \text{Au}$$

> 💡 **Memory Hook:** *"**P**lease **S**top **C**alling **M**e **A** **C**areless **Z**ebra, **I**nstead **T**ry **L**earning **H**ow **C**opper **S**aves **G**old"*
- **P**otassium (K), **S**odium (Na), **C**alcium (Ca), **M**agnesium (Mg), **A**luminium (Al), **C**arbon, **Z**inc (Zn), **I**ron (Fe), **T**in (Sn), **L**ead (Pb), **H**ydrogen (H), **C**opper (Cu), **S**ilver (Ag), **G**old (Au).

**Key Rule:** Any metal placed *above* Hydrogen displaces $H_2$ gas from dilute acids (e.g. $HCl, H_2SO_4$).

metadata.hook: Please Stop Calling Me A Careless Zebra Instead Try Learning How Copper Saves Gold
metadata.application: Predicting spontaneous single displacement reactions and galvanic cell potentials.

### 🌈 4-Band Carbon Resistor Color Code

$$\text{Color Digit Mapping: } 0 \text{ to } 9$$

> 💡 **Memory Hook:** *"**B** **B** **ROY** of **G**reat **B**ritain had a **V**ery **G**ood **W**ife wearing **G**old & **S**ilver"*
- **B**lack (0), **B**rown (1), **R**ed (2), **O**range (3), **Y**ellow (4), **G**reen (5), **B**lue (6), **V**iolet (7), **G**rey (8), **W**hite (9)
- **Tolerance Bands:** Gold ($\pm 5\%$), Silver ($\pm 10\%$), No Band ($\pm 20\%$)

**Standard Equation:**
$$R = (AB \times 10^C \pm D)\,\Omega$$

metadata.hook: BB ROY of Great Britain had a Very Good Wife (Gold & Silver)
metadata.application: Quick color code reading for 1-mark and practical lab viva questions.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.body:
### 📐 Signs of Trigonometric Ratios in Quadrants (ASTC / CAST Rule)

> 💡 **Memory Hook (Quadrants I \to IV):** *"**A**ll **S**ilver **T**ea **C**ups"* or *"**A**ll **S**tudents **T**ake **C**alculus"*

- **Quadrant I ($0^\circ - 90^\circ$):** **A**ll ratios ($\sin, \cos, \tan, \cot, \sec, \csc$) are **Positive (+)**
- **Quadrant II ($90^\circ - 180^\circ$):** **S**ine & Cosecant are **Positive (+)**
- **Quadrant III ($180^\circ - 270^\circ$):** **T**angent & Cotangent are **Positive (+)**
- **Quadrant IV ($270^\circ - 360^\circ$):** **C**osine & Secant are **Positive (+)**

$$\sin(180^\circ - \theta) = +\sin\theta, \quad \cos(180^\circ - \theta) = -\cos\theta, \quad \tan(180^\circ - \theta) = -\tan\theta$$

metadata.application: Determining sign changes for allied angles: (90 ± θ), (180 ± θ), (270 ± θ), (360 ± θ).

items.subject: Chemistry
items.body:
### 🔬 Directive Influence in Monosubstituted Benzene

> 💡 **Memory Hook:** *"**D**onors Love **O**utside (Ortho/Para), **W**ithdrawers Stay in **M**iddle (Meta)"*

- **+M / +I (Electron Donating Groups):** Activate the ring and direct electrophiles to **Ortho & Para** positions.
  - Examples: $-\text{OH}, -\text{NH}_2, -\text{OCH}_3, -\text{CH}_3$.
- **-M / -I (Electron Withdrawing Groups):** Deactivate the ring and direct to **Meta** position.
  - Examples: $-\text{NO}_2, -\text{CHO}, -\text{COOH}, -\text{CN}, -\text{SO}_3\text{H}$.
- ⚠️ **Key CBSE Board Exception:** Halogens ($-\text{Cl}, -\text{Br}, -\text{I}$) are *deactivating* (-I effect dominates) but *ortho/para directing* due to +M resonance!

metadata.application: Directing products in Nitration, Halogenation, Sulfonation & Friedel-Crafts reactions.

items.subject: Physics
items.body:
### 🧲 Fleming's Left-Hand Rule (Electric Motors)

> 💡 **Memory Hook:** **"FBI"** — Federal Bureau of Investigation

Stretch thumb, forefinger, and middle finger mutually perpendicular to each other:
1. **F** (Thumb) $\rightarrow$ Direction of **F**orce / Motion on the conductor ($F = I(L \times B)$)
2. **B** (Forefinger / First Finger) $\rightarrow$ Direction of Magnetic **F**ield ($B$)
3. **I** (Middle Finger / Center) $\rightarrow$ Direction of Electric **C**urrent ($I$)

$$\vec{F} = I(\vec{L} \times \vec{B}) \implies F = I L B \sin\theta$$

metadata.hook: FBI (Force = Thumb, B-Field = Forefinger, I-Current = Middle Finger)
metadata.application: Determining force direction on current-carrying conductors in magnetic fields.

### 🧬 Linnaean Taxonomic Hierarchy

**Order from Broadest to Most Specific Category:**
$$\text{Domain} \rightarrow \text{Kingdom} \rightarrow \text{Phylum} \rightarrow \text{Class} \rightarrow \text{Order} \rightarrow \text{Family} \rightarrow \text{Genus} \rightarrow \text{Species}$$

> 💡 **Memory Hook:** *"**D**ear **K**ing **P**hilip **C**ame **O**ver **F**or **G**ood **S**oup"*
- **D**omain, **K**ingdom, **P**hylum (Division for plants), **C**lass, **O**rder, **F**amily, **G**enus, **S**pecies.

metadata.hook: Dear King Philip Came Over For Good Soup
metadata.application: Order of biological classification ranks in board exam MCQs.
